IMAGINE SUMMER DAYS BY THE POOL, COOL EVENINGS AROUND THE FIRE PIT AND WINTER NIGHTS IN THE HOT TUB AFTER A DAY ON THE SLOPES. SIGNIFICANT UPDATES INCLUDE THE POOL AND HOT TUB, ALL-NEW TRIPLE-PANE WINDOWS, NEW ROOF AND NEW WALKWAYS. THESE IMPROVEMENTS ADD TO THE APPEAL AND FUNCTIONALITY OF THIS SPECIAL PROPERTY. WHETHER CONTINUING ITS TRADITION AS SAISONS BED & BREAKFAST, CREATING A PRIVATE FAMILY COMPOUND, OR SIMPLY ENJOYING A SPACIOUS ELLICOTTVILLE RETREAT, THIS PROPERTY OFFERS A RARE COMBINATION OF ACCOMMODATIONS, AMENITIES AND LOCATION. COME EXPERIENCE THIS BEAUTIFUL HOME JUST OUTSIDE THE VILLAGE—CLOSE ENOUGH TO WALK TO EVERYTHING ELLICOTTVILLE HAS TO OFFER!
